name: Midchain
text: Midchain is a variant spelling of Miodhchaoin, the ogre who guards a hill in northern Lochlainn. Under that name the guardian appears in the Tuireann tale's list of tasks.

attributes.attribute: spelling variant carried by the Lochlainn ogre

okr.objective: Documents Midchain as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: The entry is a spelling cross-reference to Miodhchaoin.
Miodhchaoin guards a hill in northern Lochlainn.
